نفترس (form VIII)
# نَفْتَرِسُ (naftarisu) /naf.ta.ri.su/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِفْتَرَسَ (iftarasa)
# نُفْتَرَسُ (nuftarasu) /nuf.ta.ra.su/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَرَسَ (iftarasa)
# نَفْتَرِسَ (naftarisa) /naf.ta.ri.sa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِفْتَرَسَ (iftarasa)
# نُفْتَرَسَ (nuftarasa) /nuf.ta.ra.sa/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
